messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate on serving-rm-region-a (model-load failures). Triggered at 2025-03-10T17:14:48Z. Severity: P1. On-call: Sara.
Sara: saw the bot alert, i'm on it. pulling logs now.
Raj: I'm booting the dashboard and checking per-node metrics — CPU/GPU mem looks spiky on node-gpu-17.
Mei: observed repeated model warmup failures in the last 90s: OOM during load + deserialization errors. stack snippet: ```ERROR: model_warmup:OOM allocating 1.2GiB
ERROR: model_deserialize: checksum mismatch, fallback failed```
Sara: confirmed, kube shows CrashLoopBackOff for pod serving-abc-7 on node-gpu-17. also a CUDA driver panic in dmesg: ```NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 79, PID 23819, GPU has fallen off the bus```
Alex: that CUDA Xid 79 usually means driver reset -> kernel-level issue. rolling a node drain?
Raj: before draining, recommend immediate mitigation to reduce impact: 1) disable model warmup on new pods (env DISABLE_WARMUP=1), 2) route traffic to region-b fallback pool, 3) enable model variant quantized-v2 as fallback.
Priya: setting up a canary traffic rule now to shift ~30% to region-b. doing it gradually.
Sara: Mei, can you push patch to the deployment to add DISABLE_WARMUP env and rollout with zero-downtime? Use kubectl set env and incremental restart.
Mei: applying: ```kubectl -n inference set env deployment/serving-abc DISABLE_WARMUP=true && kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-abc --selector=pool=region-a```
DeployBot: rollout started for deployment/serving-abc at 2025-03-10T17:16:12Z.
Sara: also toggling runtime flag to prefer quantized-v2 fallback: /api/flags/serve?model_fallback=quantized-v2 -> done.
Raj: checking logs on the restarted pods — warmup step is skipped but we still intermittently see deserialization errors on some replicas; probably corrupted artifact on node-gpu-17's disk.
Alex: proposing to cordon node-gpu-17 and move pods off it to prevent further flapping. cordon + drain queued.
Priya: reroute update now at 60% to region-b; error rate dropping from 18% to 4% on the dashboard. customers getting fewer 5xx.
Sara: initiating cordon: ```kubectl cordon node-gpu-17 && kubectl drain node-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force```
Mei: drain failing for one pod due to local-volume.lock. looks like artifact storage stuck. I'm creating a short-lived PVC migration to pull a fresh artifact copy.
Raj: I see a kernel OOM kill pattern targeted at the loader process before the CUDA Xid. Likely memory fragmentation under heavy concurrency. For medium-term fix, we'll lower max_concurrent_warmups to 1 per GPU and enforce artifact checksum on startup.
Alex: agreed. I'm patching the runtime config: ```max_concurrent_warmups: 1
artifact_checksum_enforce: true``` pushing in 2m.
Priya: customer impact update: Support ticket queue shows ~42 customers experienced brief 5xxs (avg 70s); I've posted initial comms to the affected customers and flagged high-value accounts.
Sara: good. for the immediate fix — warmup disabled + fallback to quantized-v2 + cordon/drain node fixed the main signal. node now shows healthy after reboot.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation in progress. Current error rate 3.5%. Next update in 10m.
Raj: post-mortem notes I'm capturing: root cause likely combination of corrupted artifact on node leading to repeated deserialize failures while concurrent warmups triggered memory pressure -> CUDA driver reset.
Mei: logs for artifact corruption: ```ERROR: artifact_fetch:read failed EIO at offset ... checksum mismatch, file truncated``` saving to /tmp/incident-1749998888/artifact.log
Alex: ops plan: repro on staging with same artifact + high concurrency to validate lower concurrency throttle and artifact checksum enforcement.
Priya: I filed INC-2025-1749 and assigned to platform; comms draft ready for customer success review.
Sara: thanks all. I'm staying on until this is 0.5% error and node pools stabilized. Next steps: RCA runbook, backfill metrics, and schedule kernel/driver upgrade for affected pool.
DeployBot: rollout of DISABLE_WARMUP env completed at 2025-03-10T17:23:24Z.
incident-bot: Incident resolved to P2 at 2025-03-10T17:29:04Z. Final error rate: 0.8%. Please continue follow-ups in #postmortems.
Sara: adding immediate action items to the incident doc: short-term: force artifact re-sync on any node with checksum mismatch, medium-term: disable concurrent warmups by default, long-term: driver upgrade + improve warmup isolation. will link ticket when ready. :thumbsup:
